result.reason: The redline improves the Deliverable warranty to the 90-day fallback and preserves repair, replacement, re-performance, and refund remedies. However, it does not provide the required 30-day Services warranty period, compliance-with-laws warranty, or no-malicious-code warranty. It also unnecessarily changes the trigger from delivery to acceptance and uses the redundant formulation “materially conform in all material respects,” so it is not a minimal or fully precise implementation of the playbook.
